threats.title: Notes linkable to a person across exports
threats.description: Notes are stored with the account email as the key, so a leaked table or backup ties every note to a named person.

mitigations.text: Key notes by an opaque user id, not by email address.
Keep email addresses in a separate table from note text.

threats.title: Users not told what is kept about them
threats.description: The sign-in flow collects an email address and sets a cookie without telling the user what is stored or for how long.

mitigations.text: Show a privacy notice listing stored data and retention before sign-up.

threats.title: Notes cannot be deleted with the account
threats.description: Deleting an account leaves its notes behind, which breaks deletion requests.

mitigations.text: Delete or anonymise all notes when an account is deleted.
